evals.prompt: I want a feature that lets users share their saved lists, but I am not sure how it should work yet. Help me think it through.
evals.expected_output: Collaborative exploration: context check, one question at a time, 2 to 3 approaches, validated design, no code.
assertions: Writes NO code or implementation action before a design is presented and approved (hard gate)
Asks clarifying questions one at a time, preferring multiple choice
Proposes 2 to 3 approaches with trade-offs and leads with a recommendation
Presents the design in sections and asks after each whether it looks right
After approval documents the design in docs/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>-design.md

evals.prompt: Let's brainstorm how the notification system should work before we build anything.
evals.expected_output: Explores purpose, constraints and success criteria first, then proposes approaches.
assertions: Checks current project state (files, docs, recent commits) first
Focuses questions on purpose, constraints and success criteria
Applies YAGNI by removing unnecessary features
Transitions to the plan skill only after design approval

evals.prompt: Rename the function getUser to fetchUser across the repo.
evals.expected_output: A clear mechanical task with no design exploration needed.
assertions: Does not start a design interview
Performs or plans the rename directly
